items.title: “Share Donor”: Fortinet Sinks 31% in a Week Despite Beating and Raising Guidance
items.summary: Key TakeawaysFortinet stock fell 31% in the past week after its third-quarter report, though revenue grew 20% and the company raised its 2026 outlook. Investors sold on slower product growth and lagging service revenue, while ServiceNow’s report weighed on software stocks too.
